figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of jina-reranker-v3.5. (a) LBNL listwise encoding with a 3L2G hybrid backbone and pinned terminal global layer (G*). (b) Three-stage self-distillation from a full-attention teacher to a sparse-attention student.
